metrics.name: T_identity_canonical_scope_digest
metrics.label: canonicalScopeDigest over verification_scope.lock
metrics.methodology: Reads data/verification_scope.lock, parses kernel_symbols/kernel_exempt_symbols/kernel_total/vksTotal, constructs CanonicalScopeInput, calls canonicalScopeDigest (pure SHA-256 of sorted parts).

metrics.name: T_identity_combineHashes_10
metrics.label: combineHashes on 10 parts (compositional digest scaling probe)
metrics.methodology: Calls combineHashes (domain-separator SHA-256) on 10 synthetic string parts; measures compositional digest cost scaling.

metrics.name: T_identity_combineHashes_100
metrics.label: combineHashes on 100 parts (compositional digest scaling probe)
metrics.methodology: Calls combineHashes (domain-separator SHA-256) on 100 synthetic string parts; measures compositional digest cost scaling.

metrics.name: T_identity_combineHashes_1000
metrics.label: combineHashes on 1000 parts (compositional digest scaling probe)
metrics.methodology: Calls combineHashes (domain-separator SHA-256) on 1000 synthetic string parts; measures compositional digest cost scaling.

metrics.name: T_identity_source_tree_hash
metrics.label: computeSourceTreeHash over src/
metrics.methodology: Walks src/ recursively, filters .nim files (excl. /generated/), sorts, concatenates content, SHA-256; measured via benchmark_cost_probe tool.

metrics.name: T_selection
metrics.label: selection_report end-to-end wall time (HEAD~5..HEAD, v2 symbols file with synthetic call edges)
metrics.methodology: Time from shell invocation of selection_report tool using time command. Includes compilation + execution. Report planStatus=VALID, selected=0 (empty dependency graph — call edges not yet wired).

metrics.name: T_selection_w3
metrics.label: selection_report end-to-end wall time (HEAD~100..HEAD, real symbols file with call edges)
metrics.methodology: Time from shell invocation of selection_report tool using time command. Includes compilation + execution. Report planStatus=VALID, selected=4 (real dependency edges from source code).

ratio.methodology: Selected count (4) from W3 selection_report report (planStatus=VALID, selected=4 with real call edges). Universe base: VKS count (23 non-exempt kernel symbols from verification_scope.lock). Diff range: HEAD~100..HEAD.
